name: tsai-cli
description: Unofficial, unaffiliated CLI for the TypeSafe AI System One API, built for testing and prototyping. Typed judgments (noul, choice, score) for shells, CI, and coding agents.
author: Albert Peci

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --outdir dist --external @typesafe-ai/sdk && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
